templates.title: Golden groove
templates.prompt: Create a natural, rhythmic dance with fluid full-body movement and a steady camera. Keep the person recognizable.

templates.title: City moves
templates.prompt: Animate a relaxed urban dance, with natural body motion and steady framing.

templates.title: Studio rhythm
templates.prompt: Animate a graceful dance, keeping facial features and clothing consistent.

templates.title: Together in motion
templates.prompt: Create a gentle synchronized dance with natural movement.

templates.title: A moment, alive
templates.prompt: Bring this photograph to life with subtle smiles, a gentle breeze, and a slow cinematic camera movement. Preserve the people and the mood.

templates.title: A familiar smile
templates.prompt: Animate this portrait with a warm smile and natural blinking. Keep the camera steady and preserve facial identity.

templates.title: Birthday glow
templates.prompt: Create a joyful birthday scene with warm light and softly falling confetti.

templates.title: Just us
templates.prompt: Animate an affectionate moment with soft sunset light, natural expressions, and a gentle camera push-in.

templates.title: City escape
templates.prompt: Create a cinematic travel moment with a gentle tracking shot and lively background.

templates.title: Golden afternoon
templates.prompt: Animate a relaxed afternoon in a flower field with a gentle breeze and warm sunshine.

templates.title: Forever begins
templates.prompt: Create an elegant wedding-inspired scene with soft floral details and romantic light.

templates.title: Playful companion
templates.prompt: Animate the pet with playful, natural movement and a gentle breeze. Preserve its appearance and keep the camera steady.

templates.title: Soft light
templates.prompt: Create a polished seated editorial studio portrait matching the preview's quiet, warm character. When a reference photo is supplied, keep the same recognizable person: preserve facial structure, eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, hairline, hairstyle, and all distinctive features without beautifying or replacing the face. Use a warm cocoa-taupe seamless background with subtle tonal falloff. Style the subject in a relaxed cream or ivory blouse with natural fabric texture while respecting their original gender presentation and body proportions. Compose from the waist up at eye level, with one hand resting lightly near the chin only if anatomically natural, relaxed shoulders, direct gentle eye contact, and a calm expression. Use an 85 mm portrait-camera look, a large soft directional key from camera-left, gentle fill, soft catchlights, and realistic jaw shadows. Retain pores, fine hair, facial asymmetry, and natural skin texture; avoid waxy skin, excessive retouching, face reshaping, distorted fingers, extra jewelry, text, logos, or distracting props.

templates.title: Neon nights
templates.prompt: Create a cinematic three-quarter night portrait matching the preview: one subject beneath a clear transparent umbrella on a rain-wet neon city street, wearing an elegant dark coat or similarly refined dark outerwear. When a reference photo is supplied, preserve the subject's exact recognizable identity, facial geometry, age, skin tone, hair, body build, and distinctive details; do not face-swap, idealize, or change ethnicity. Keep the face unobstructed and sharply readable through the umbrella, with a composed natural expression and believable hand placement on the umbrella handle. Surround the subject with blue, cyan, magenta, and warm storefront bokeh reflected across glossy pavement, without readable signage or duplicated people. Use an eye-level 50 mm environmental-portrait look, moderate shallow depth of field, crisp facial detail, realistic raindrops on the clear canopy, physically consistent mixed-color light, and restrained cinematic contrast. Preserve accurate skin color under neon spill and avoid plastic skin, warped umbrellas, distorted limbs, extra fingers, smeared facial features, fake text, logos, borders, or watermarks.

templates.title: Golden muse
templates.prompt: Create a luminous full-length golden-hour editorial portrait matching the preview: the subject stands in a soft garden holding a small natural bouquet of white daisies, wearing an elegant flowing blush-peach dress with translucent sleeves and realistic layered fabric. When a reference photo is supplied, keep the same person's unmistakable face, facial proportions, age, skin tone, hairline, hairstyle, and unique features; wardrobe and setting may change, but the face must not be regenerated or cosmetically redesigned. Use a relaxed centered pose, anatomically correct hands gently holding the flower stems, a quiet natural expression, and graceful posture. Place the low sun behind and slightly camera-left for warm hair rim light, with soft frontal fill that preserves accurate skin tones. Use an eye-level 70 mm fashion-editorial look, gentle depth of field, softly blurred greenery and small flowers, warm cream highlights, and restrained pastel color. Avoid fantasy glow, overexposed skin, altered identity, doll-like features, duplicate limbs, artificial-looking flowers, distorted fingers, text, logos, borders, or watermarks.

templates.title: Two of a kind
templates.prompt: Create an intimate seated studio portrait of exactly the people present in the reference image, matching the preview's comfortable close pose against a warm cocoa-brown background. Preserve each person's separate recognizable identity: keep their individual facial geometry, age, skin tone, hair, height relationship, body proportions, and distinguishing features, and never blend their faces or make them look like clones. Seat the subjects close together with subtle affectionate body language, relaxed shoulders, a gentle lean, and genuine restrained smiles rather than exaggerated posing. Style one subject in a dark charcoal knit and the other in a soft cream knit, or use similarly coordinated neutral clothing appropriate to their presentation, with realistic fabric texture. Use an eye-level 70 to 85 mm portrait-camera look, soft directional window-style key light, gentle fill, clean catchlights, and smooth background falloff. Keep hands anatomically correct and clearly attached, preserve believable contact, and retain natural skin texture. Do not add another person, alter age or ethnicity, reshape faces, create clone features, over-smooth skin, add text, logos, props, borders, or watermarks.

templates.title: Tiny world
templates.prompt: Create the playful photorealistic miniature-world scene shown in the preview: the reference subject sits safely on the rim of an enormous white coffee cup on a sunny European-style café table, with oversized flaky croissants beside the cup and softly blurred shopfronts and flowers behind. Preserve the subject's exact recognizable face, age, skin tone, hairstyle, body proportions, and distinctive details; never replace, stylize, beautify, or shrink the facial features into a generic face. Dress the subject in relaxed light-neutral knitwear and blue jeans, or equivalent casual clothing appropriate to their presentation, with believable folds. Use a low camera level relative to the miniature subject, realistic perspective, consistent scale cues, natural seated balance, anatomically correct hands and feet, firm contact with the cup rim, accurate contact shadows, and matching warm sunlight. Keep the face clearly readable. The composite must resemble a carefully photographed practical effect rather than a pasted collage. Avoid duplicated people, floating limbs, inconsistent scale, warped cup geometry, merged croissants, distorted anatomy, fake signage, captions, logos, borders, or watermarks.

templates.title: Your next chapter
templates.prompt: Create a dignified waist-up graduation portrait matching the preview while keeping the reference subject completely recognizable. Preserve facial structure, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, hairline, hairstyle, body proportions, and distinctive features; do not beautify, age-shift, or replace the face. Dress the subject in a well-fitted black academic gown, square mortarboard with correctly placed tassel, and a simple gold stole with realistic fabric folds. Let them hold a rolled diploma tied with a red ribbon using anatomically correct hands, but include no readable invented text. Pose them confidently with relaxed shoulders and a genuine restrained smile. Place them on a softly blurred historic university campus with stone arches, green trees, and warm late-afternoon light. Use an eye-level 70 to 85 mm portrait-camera look, soft directional key light, balanced fill, natural catchlights, and realistic skin texture. Do not alter ethnicity or gender presentation, distort the cap or fingers, over-retouch skin, add institutional logos, captions, borders, or watermarks.

templates.title: Memories restored
templates.prompt: Restore the supplied family photograph conservatively into a clean, natural color portrait like the preview, while treating every visible person, object, pose, expression, garment, and background element as protected source content. Preserve each person's exact recognizable facial identity, age, ethnicity, skin tone, hair, body proportions, gaze direction, relative height, and relationship to the other subjects. Respect original traditional clothing, jewelry, and period details; do not modernize or replace them. Repair only genuine scratches, dust, tears, stains, fading, color casts, low contrast, and small missing areas. Reconstruct damage from adjacent evidence without inventing facial features, changing expressions, repositioning hands, or moving subjects. Recover warm natural skin color, believable cream and neutral clothing tones, fine but not artificial detail, and subtle film grain. Keep the original seated-and-standing family composition, crop, veranda-like environment, perspective, depth of field, and lighting direction. Avoid aggressive sharpening, waxy skin, face enhancement, symmetry correction, oversaturation, added people or objects, fake text, logos, borders, or watermarks. If evidence is ambiguous, preserve it softly rather than fabricating detail.

templates.title: An evening to remember
templates.prompt: Create an elegant full-length prom-night editorial portrait matching the preview, with the reference subject remaining unmistakably the same person. Preserve exact facial geometry, age, skin tone, ethnicity, eye shape, nose, lips, jawline, hairline, hairstyle, and distinctive features; do not face-swap, reshape, or apply unrealistic beauty retouching. Style the subject in a refined floor-length lavender formal gown with long sleeves, clean tailoring, realistic fabric drape, and restrained accessories appropriate to their presentation. Pose them centered with relaxed shoulders, hands gently joined at the waist, correct fingers, and a genuine composed expression. Place them on an upscale outdoor terrace at blue hour with pale flowers, small lanterns and candles, a warm chandelier overhead, and distant architecture softly out of focus. Light the face with a large soft key and gentle fill for accurate dimensional skin, plus a subtle warm rim light. Use a 70 mm portrait-camera look and polished cinematic color without crushed shadows. Avoid altered identity, mannequin skin, implausible clothing, distorted hands, extra people, fake text, logos, borders, or watermarks.

templates.title: Birthday wishes
templates.prompt: Create a joyful but sophisticated seated birthday portrait matching the preview. Preserve the reference person's exact recognizable face, facial proportions, age, skin tone, hairline, hairstyle, body build, and distinctive details; do not replace the face, change ethnicity, or make the subject younger or artificially perfected. Style them in an elegant dusty-rose or blush formal dress with realistic embroidery and fabric texture. Seat them beside a small round table with a tasteful pink floral cake and candles, one hand relaxed near the face only if anatomically natural, and a warm genuine smile. Arrange pale-pink balloons, delicate flowers, and warm fairy-light bokeh behind the subject without covering the face. Use soft peach-and-cream ambient light balanced by a flattering directional key and gentle fill, preserving real skin texture and accurate color. Use a 70 to 85 mm portrait-camera look with moderate depth of field and clean separation. Avoid excessive decorations, unreadable cake text, duplicate features, distorted fingers, face reshaping, plastic skin, logos, captions, borders, or watermarks.

templates.title: Golden together
templates.prompt: Create a romantic golden-hour waist-up portrait matching the preview and containing exactly the people visible in the reference image. Preserve each person's distinct recognizable facial identity, age, skin tone, hair, body proportions, relative height, and unique features; never merge their faces, exchange features, or turn them into look-alike clones. Keep their connection natural through eye contact, a gentle hand resting on an arm, and relaxed posture. Style one subject in a flowing deep-blue outfit and the other in a light ivory linen shirt, or use similarly coordinated colors appropriate to their presentation, with realistic fabric texture. Place them in a sunlit green garden with soft architecture and foliage behind, the low sun producing warm hair rim light and balanced soft fill across both faces. Use an eye-level 70 mm portrait-camera look, natural perspective, shallow background separation, and detailed skin and hair. Ensure hands and arm contact are anatomically correct. Avoid altered identities, extra people, duplicated limbs, warped fingers, over-orange skin, artificial glow, fake text, logos, borders, or watermarks.

templates.title: First impression
templates.prompt: Create a credible chest-up professional profile and LinkedIn headshot matching the preview while keeping the reference subject unmistakably the same person. Preserve exact facial structure, eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, ears, skin tone, age, hairline, hairstyle, facial hair, and distinctive marks; do not beautify, slim, age-shift, face-swap, or change ethnicity. Frame at eye level with squared but relaxed shoulders, confident posture, direct natural eye contact, and a subtle approachable smile. Style the subject in a clean charcoal or deep-navy business jacket over a crisp light shirt, or equivalent polished attire appropriate to their presentation, with realistic tailoring and no visible brand. Use a simple softly graduated light-gray studio background with no objects or signage. Apply an 85 mm headshot-camera look, large soft key light, gentle fill, natural catchlights, accurate skin color, and restrained background blur. Retain pores, fine hair, and facial asymmetry without harsh sharpening. Avoid glamour retouching, plastic skin, exaggerated makeup, distorted lapels, asymmetrical eyes, extra accessories, text, company logos, borders, or watermarks.

legal.privacy:
Effective date: September 23, 2026

Genora AI Image & Video Editor ("Genora") provides tools that create and edit images and videos. This policy explains how information is handled when you use the app.

Information we process
• Account data: email address, password hash, account identifier, session information, coin balance, subscription status, and account creation date.
• Creative content: prompts, selected input images, generated images or videos, template choices, and generation history.
• Purchase data: Google Play product identifiers, purchase tokens, transaction status, and entitlement information. We do not receive your complete payment-card details.
• Support and safety data: content reports, report reasons, optional details, and related generation identifiers.
• Technical data: service requests, timestamps, error information, and security logs needed to operate and protect the service.

How we use information
We use this information to provide generation and editing features, maintain accounts and balances, verify purchases, process subscriptions, prevent abuse, investigate reported content, provide support, secure the service, and comply with legal obligations.

AI processing and service providers
When you start an AI generation, your prompt and selected input media are sent through Genora's backend to the configured AI generation provider. Hosting, database, object-storage, AI-processing, and Google Play service providers process data only as needed to provide their services. Do not upload content you do not have permission to use.

Storage and retention
Private input uploads are scheduled for deletion after 72 hours when they are no longer required by an active generation. Generated server files and generation records may remain available with your account until you delete the account or they are removed under our retention and safety procedures. Copies you save to your device are controlled by you and are not removed by deleting the server account. Security, billing, and audit records may be retained when required for fraud prevention, dispute handling, or law.

Sharing
We do not sell personal information. Information is shared with service providers described above, when you direct us to share or export content, when required by law, or when necessary to protect users, the public, and the service.

Your choices and deletion
You can delete your account inside the app or at /account-deletion. Account deletion permanently removes the account and associated server uploads and generated files, except information we must retain for legal, security, billing, or fraud-prevention purposes. You can control photo access through Android settings and can avoid AI upload features by using only on-device editing tools.

Children
Genora is not directed to children below the minimum digital-consent age that applies in their country. Do not use the service or upload a child's personal information unless you are legally permitted to do so.

Security and changes
We use access controls, encryption in transit, limited retention, and other safeguards, but no online service can guarantee absolute security. We may update this policy when the app or legal requirements change and will publish the updated version with a new effective date.

Contact
Use the support email shown in the app and on this website for privacy or support questions.
legal.terms:
Effective date: September 23, 2026

These Terms of Use govern your use of Genora AI Image & Video Editor ("Genora"). By using the app, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

Eligibility and accounts
You must be legally able to agree to these terms in your country. Keep your credentials secure and provide accurate account information. You are responsible for activity performed through your account.

Creative tools and AI results
Genora can edit media on your device and can send prompts and selected media to a configured AI provider to create images or videos. AI output is probabilistic and may be inaccurate, unexpected, or similar to other content. Review every result before using or sharing it. We do not guarantee that output is unique, error-free, suitable for a particular purpose, or available continuously.

Your content
You retain any rights you have in content you upload. You grant Genora and its service providers a limited right to host, copy, process, and transmit that content only as needed to operate, secure, and improve the requested service and enforce these terms. You must have the necessary rights and permissions for every prompt, image, video, person, trademark, and other material you submit.

Prohibited use
Do not use Genora to create, upload, or distribute illegal content; child sexual abuse or exploitation material; non-consensual intimate imagery; deceptive impersonation or fraud; instructions that facilitate serious harm; hateful, harassing, or violent abuse; malware; or content that violates privacy, publicity, copyright, trademark, or other rights. Do not bypass safeguards, automate abusive requests, interfere with the service, or resell access without written permission. Report unsafe generated content using the Report action on its result screen.

Coins, subscriptions, and Google Play
Where enabled, digital coins and subscriptions are purchased through Google Play. Prices and billing periods shown by Google Play control the transaction. Coin purchases are consumable and subscriptions renew according to the selected Play offer until cancelled. Manage cancellation through Google Play. Purchase restoration and refund handling depend on Google Play records and applicable law. Fraudulent, refunded, or reversed purchases may remove related coins or benefits. Premium generation may be subject to reasonable-use, safety, concurrency, and technical limits.

Service changes and enforcement
Features, models, prices, limits, and availability may change. We may suspend or terminate access for safety, fraud, legal, or material terms violations. We may remove reported content or preserve limited records when reasonably necessary for investigation or legal compliance.

Disclaimers and liability
The service is provided on an "as available" basis to the extent permitted by law. You are responsible for deciding whether content is appropriate and lawful for your use. Nothing in these terms excludes consumer rights or liability that cannot legally be excluded.

Account deletion
You can permanently delete your account in the app or at /account-deletion. Deletion does not remove copies already exported to your device or shared elsewhere and does not cancel a Google Play subscription; cancel subscriptions separately in Google Play.

Changes and contact
We may update these terms and will publish the revised version with an updated effective date. Use the support email shown in the app and on this website for questions.
